name: I used to be their 10/10 daughter
source: /Users/aaron/Downloads/100 Viral Formats (Format Book)/Easy to use format/#11/#11.mp4

lines.ref: I used to be their 10/10 daughter
9/10 when I said no to them
8/10 when i said no to their choice
5/10 when I made my own decision

audit.notes: Perfect fit for the creator's library. Replicate by selecting 10 varied 2-second clips (walking in NY, studying/working on laptop, eating, sitting in Central Park, crossing streets with coffee) and overlaying the 10/10 down to 1/10 boundary/independence text hook.
audit.summary: A countdown b-roll montage showing how the creator went from a '10/10 daughter' down to '1/10' in her parents' eyes as she set boundaries, made her own choices, and chose herself.
